about: Hand-labelled eligibility terms for the Clerk extraction eval. Every label was checked against the saved snapshot named in 'snapshot' (official page text, fetched on the 'fetched' date and turned into text with src/sources/fetchPage.js htmlToText). 'accept' lists every acceptable answer; null means the page does not state it, so the right answer is 'unknown' (inventing a value is an error). 'contains:x' passes if the extracted list has an entry containing x. Each label carries the sentences that justify it ('quotes', each found verbatim in the snapshot; test/gold.test.js checks this) or, when the page is silent, a 'why' note. 'trap' marks labels where a reader would assume an answer the page does not give.
